# Reviewed historical findings, accepted as known.
#
# Entries are keyed hashes of a blob id (see scripts/pii-hashes.py), not the id
# itself. This file is public, and a plain list of object ids would be a
# ready-made index pointing at exactly the objects worth looking at.
#
# History cannot be edited without a rewrite, so a finding that has been
# reviewed and accepted belongs here and stops being reported. Add an entry
# deliberately, after deciding the value is rotated or harmless. Never add one
# to silence a hit you have not looked at: that converts this whole job into a
# green light that means nothing.
#
# Regenerate the whole file with:
#   PRISM_PII_SALT=... python3 scripts/pii-hashes.py scan-history --write-baseline
#
# Deliberately EMPTY. The first sweep's findings are real and undecided, so
# they are left reported rather than pre-accepted.
